timing: Frozen after calibration scope diagnosis and local follow-up, before validation model inference/search.

policy_definitions.timing: Exploratory follow-up designed after scope diagnostics; not preregistered before seeing calibration labels. No validation/test or hyperparameter search.
policy_definitions.scope: Online relations use only immediate 8-connected neighbors in the same original RGB-change quartile. Never use shared-building UID exclusions online; these were evaluator diagnostic controls only.
policy_definitions.local_residual: For each unvisited candidate, sum latest per-neighbor (TPR-FPR)^2 * (source posterior-original source prior); logit shift clip(4*sum/(8+sum reliability),-1,1). Both signs. Original v1 constants unchanged.
policy_definitions.local_positive: Same local residual formula but include only latest detector-positive source neighbors; negative sources contribute neither residual nor denominator. Observation quality represented by same fixed reliability.
policy_definitions.neighbor_positive: Simple baseline: candidate logit +0.25 if any latest detector-positive eligible neighbor exists, otherwise zero; independent of number of positive neighbors or likelihood values. Fixed modest bias, not tuned.
policy_definitions.cell_posteriors: All three local policies use the unchanged quality posterior for observed cells, anchored to their original fitted prior. Only unvisited scores receive neighbor corrections.
policy_definitions.correlation: One registry representative per sample/cell. Upgrade replaces blurred result: recompute from frozen original cell prior using native likelihood, not previous posterior. Current peer residual replaced too.
policy_definitions.actions: Survey costs 1; a negative blurred survey permits one native quality upgrade costing 2. Positive regions terminal for all policies; native survey has no further upgrade. No direct native request on an unvisited region in degraded-survey conditions.
policy_definitions.selection: Expected target-presence detections per cost: unvisited probability * scenario-average sensitivity; upgrade latest cell probability * native sensitivity / 2. Common forecast rates across feedback methods; Euclidean distance breaks ties, no travel charge.
policy_definitions.cost_scope: Controlled quality-restoration proxy with declared 1:2 action costs; not measured compute, flight time, UAV viewpoints, or a claim that reprocessing recovers genuinely lost information.
policy_definitions.paired_design: Reuse all v1 control trajectories unchanged after hash checks. Run three new local policies on exactly the same fixed observation map and budgets; report all outcomes.
policy_definitions.progression_rule: Do not present a contribution or spend test events if local residual policies cannot consistently beat the simple neighbor-positive and quality-gate controls across budgets and events. Gains concentrated in a few scenes remain exploratory.
limitations: Calibration data reused to fit sensor/prior and run these diagnostics: no held-out policy result.
Checkpoint training exposure expected; two events, no real UAV measurements.
Presence-oriented acquisition and terminal positive cells may miss additional buildings in dense positive cells.
Coverage-based building matching is an evaluator proxy, not instance AP; spatial peers are not guaranteed exchangeable.
Fixed-radius same-bin relation motivated by this calibration data, with no held-out confirmation.
Local detector-positive neighbors may refer to the same crossing building; unique discovery evaluator removes repeat counts but the planner does not know true object IDs.
The 0.25 simple-bias constant is an engineering comparator choice; no claim it is the strongest possible local heuristic.

fit: Apply original calibration bin edges, bin probabilities and mode likelihoods unchanged. No event-specific fit, threshold tuning or score-dependent filtering. Report every frozen policy/condition/budget.
diagnostics: Report validation cell detection rates, prior Brier versus original-calibration global probability, event-level policy differences and scene pairs. No confidence based on treating grid cells or quality seeds as independent events.
decision: Local residual remains a candidate only if it has a consistent incremental advantage over quality gate and simple neighbor-positive; preserve regressions and event concentration. No test run in this request.
interpretation: These two events are held out from prior/sensor/policy fitting, but checkpoint training exposure is expected. Not unseen-event perception evaluation or a real UAV deployment.
